## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install habitrack in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure habitrack package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to habitrack
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub [repository](https://github.com/doyu/habitrack):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/doyu/habitrack.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/doyu/habitrack)

``` sh
$ conda install -c doyu habitrack
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/habitrack/)

``` sh
$ pip install habitrack
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub [repository](https://github.com/doyu/habitrack)’s [pages](https://doyu.github.io/habitrack/). Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on [conda](https://anaconda.org/doyu/habitrack) and [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/habitrack/) respectively.
